text: comfortably: Heb. to the heart | warfare: Or, appointed time
straight: Or, a straight place | places plain: Or, a plain place
O Zion, that bringest good tidings: Or, O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion | O Jersulem, that bringest good tidings: Or, O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem
with strong hand: Or, against the strong | his work before him: Or, recompence for his work
that are with young: Or, that give suck
his counselor: Heb. man of his counsel
instructed him: Heb. made him understand | understanding?: Heb. understandings
is so impoverished: Heb. I poor of oblation
it is he that sitteth: Or, him that sitteth, atc.
